overall: MARGINAL today: windy on the east-facing grounds, calm on the Coron side
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination: east wind at Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Nangalao, Ciron and Barangonan (13–16 kt this morning, easing to 10–13 kt mid-afternoon), and current at Tara and Turda (0.6–0.8 kt this morning, building to 0.9–1.1 kt from about 2 PM and staying there overnight). Rain is minor: scattered light showers about 9 AM–8 PM (mostly 0.1–0.3 mm/h, Barangonan up to 0.6 mm/h about 3–5 PM), 2.5 mm regional for the day.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists a tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Fishing slipped from GOOD to MARGINAL overnight, as forecast. The east wind arrived: grounds now read 6 GOOD / 8 MARGINAL / 2 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (yesterday 2 PM: 13 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 0 POOR). Cabunlawan and Decabaitot are at 16 kt, Barangonan 15 kt and Nangalao 14 kt this morning.

Thu 5 supply slips back to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was near normal): Wednesday is now a little breezier (11 kt, gusts 17, dry; was 10 kt, gusts 16), with the east wind rebuilding to 14–16 kt before dawn Wednesday. On the plus side, Thursday is now the calmest day of the week (6.3 kt, gusts 12, dry), so Fri 6 looks firmly NORMAL. Today stays NORMAL, Wed 4 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT, Sun 8 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Tue–Mon (guide only; it reacts to the 0.5–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is light to moderate: two soft days back to back (Wed 4 and Thu 5), then Sunday. Make today's landings count and lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan and Maglalambay for Wednesday–Thursday supply.

bestWindow.headline: About 3 PM to midnight today
details: Coron, Culion and Galoc: near calm (1–3 kt) about 3 PM–midnight, current 0.2–0.6 kt. Panlaitan and Maglalambay: under 5 kt from about 11 AM to 1 AM, current 0.2–0.3. Decabobo: 1–5 kt and 0.2–0.4 kt all day. Alava and Binudac: 5–7 kt, 0.4–0.5 kt about 7 PM–midnight. Ciron: brief lull about 7 PM–1 AM (6–9 kt, 0.3 kt). Tara and Turda: only this morning, about 7–11 AM (wind 3–4 kt, current 0.6–0.7).

Keep small boats off Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Nangalao all day (11–16 kt, gusts to 21), off Barangonan this morning and after 10 PM (14–15 kt), and off Tara and Turda from about 2 PM (0.9–1.1 kt current).
